correctness.rationale: Exactly one final theorem: all n>=3 sunlet diagonal rank polynomials equal the stated formal rational coefficient extraction. The leaf blocks have nonsingular Schur eliminations; proper retained subsets induce disjoint paths, whose Jacobsthal nullity polynomial follows a one-dimensional determinant recurrence; distinguishing cyclic boundaries proves the n/k count even for periodic words; full retention is exactly the S3 product-fixed-space case, determined by parity and the standard character. The cases B empty, B proper nonempty, B full partition all masks. The rank normalization 2n-nullity and sharp extremal exponent are checked. Standalone binary elimination independently matches all 87,360 diagonal masks for n=3..8 and separate reduced enumeration n=3..10; code paths are inside the delivered package.

value.rationale: The recently studied partial Petrial rank polynomial encodes the full Euler-genus distribution of partial twists. Moving from completely classified path and T/H tree instances to the natural one-cycle corona family poses a nontrivial cyclic closure correction. The theorem supplies all coefficients uniformly at every size via an explicit rational bivariate function, plus a sharp least-rank threshold, not a single small or contrived parameter. The method combines reversible pendant elimination, a cyclic run/exponential generating calculation, and S3 monodromy; these structures can be adapted to other pendant cycle gadgets. It does not assert a paper-sized contribution or unverified downstream applications.
